test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 14 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A solid copper sphere of diameter 30 cm is drawn into a wire of diameter 10 cm. Find the length of the wire (in cm).
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the sphere = 30 cm

Radius of the sphere (r₁) = 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm

Diameter of the wire = 10 cm

Radius of the wire (r₂) = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = Volume of wire

dfrac{4}{3}pi r₁³ = pi r₂² times {length of wire (L)}

**Calculation:**

dfrac{4}{3} pi (15)³ = pi (5)² times L

⇒ dfrac{4}{3} times 15³ = 5² times L

⇒ dfrac{4}{3} times 3375 = 25 times L

⇒ dfrac{13500}{3} = 25 times L

⇒ 4500 = 25 times L

⇒ dfrac{4500}{25} = L

⇒ L = 180 cm

**∴ The length of the wire is 180 cm.**
